selection: Reuse all eight parent case centers and all original selected train neighbors; no new ranking or selection by RGB, GT, or outcomes.
normal_source: Same-source sampled camera-space depth, unweighted TLS orientation over fixed 9x9 patch. Plane offset anchored at original center depth. No independent normal evidence claimed.
holes: Require valid center; retain raw per-ray validity. Missing normal is unavailable, with no fallback plane and no source-hole filling.
comparison: Each size/view/pair uses intersection of both sources and both raw/plane projectable masks for all four costs. Single-source own-support scores are separate descriptive outputs.
score: cost=(1-ZNCC)/2; grayscale 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B; population std on identical mask; numeric flat epsilon 1e-12

diagnostic_gates.meaning: Pre-run development reading aids, not learned accuracy thresholds, supervision weights, source correctness, or execution authority. No absolute fit threshold has been calibrated.
